title: Ad-Tech-Stack-Extractor Output
description: Categorized ad tech stack detected from the input. Raw JSON only — no markdown fences, no surrounding text. Arrays contain only technologies with confirmed signal presence in the input.

ad_server.description: Ad serving platforms detected. Examples: Google Ad Manager, Google AdSense, Xandr, Freewheel. Empty array when no ad server signals are present.

items.description: Canonical technology name from the Signal Detection Reference Table.

header_bidding_wrappers.description: Header bidding wrapper libraries detected. Examples: Prebid.js, Amazon TAM / UAM, Index Exchange Wrapper. Empty array when no wrapper signals are present.

items.description: Canonical technology name from the Signal Detection Reference Table.

ssp_adapters_detected.description: Supply-side platform adapters or bidder tags detected. Examples: Amazon / APS, Rubicon / Magnite, OpenX, Index Exchange, PubMatic, Criteo. Empty array when no SSP signals are present.

items.description: Canonical technology name from the Signal Detection Reference Table.

content_recommendation.description: Content recommendation or native advertising widgets detected. Examples: Taboola, Outbrain, Revcontent. Empty array when no content recommendation signals are present.

items.description: Canonical technology name from the Signal Detection Reference Table.

confidence_score.description: Signal quality score 0–100. 0: nothing detected. 5–15: only analytics/tag managers found (no ad tech). 30–50: weak signals only (variable declarations). 60–75: 1–2 strong signals (CDN URLs or init calls). 76–90: 3+ strong signals. 91–100: full stack detected with strong signals across all categories.

constraints.output_format: Raw JSON only. No markdown code fences. No surrounding text.
constraints.no_hallucination: Arrays must only contain technologies with confirmed signal matches in the input. No inferred or assumed technologies.
constraints.exclusion_list: googletagmanager.com, gtag/js, google-analytics.com, analytics.js, GA4, segment.com, hotjar.com, fullstory.com, mixpanel.com, amplitude.com, heap.io, facebook.com/tr, pixel, quantserve.com, comscore.com, nielsen.com must never appear in any array.
constraints.canonical_names: Array values must use canonical technology names from the Signal Detection Reference Table, not raw variable names or URLs.
constraints.deduplication: Each technology name must appear at most once per array.
constraints.cross_category: A technology may appear in multiple arrays if it serves multiple roles (e.g., Amazon apstag in both header_bidding_wrappers and ssp_adapters_detected).
